page_title: MAI 2-1 EIN | Mainz v Eintracht Frankfurt 22/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Ayoube Amaimouni (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
90+3' The Eintracht Frankfurt players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
90+1' Urs Fischer has decided to substitute Sheraldo Becker and he is replaced by Lennard Maloney (Mainz).
90' We will have 8 min. of added time.
89' 2 - 1 Goal! Paul Nebel (Mainz) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:1.
89' Michael Zetterer produces a crucial save to deny a close-range header from Nelson Weiper (Mainz) after a cross. A top class save by the keeper.
86' Tobias Stieler blows his whistle and it's Ayoube Amaimouni (Eintracht Frankfurt) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
84' What a chance that is! Sheraldo Becker (Mainz) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass inside the box but is somehow only able to prod the ball onto the right post!
83' The ball possession at the moment is 31:69.
81' Substitution. Jae-Sung Lee did his best and is replaced by Sota Kawasaki (Mainz).
79' Here comes a substitution. Fares Chaibi is given a rest as he is replaced by Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt).
79' Albert Riera decides to make a substitution. Ritsu Doan will be replaced by Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt).
78' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty as the referee indicates there was no infringement.
77' There's a break in play and referee Tobias Stieler must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Mainz using VAR. This could be interesting!
76' Sheraldo Becker (Mainz) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
74' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt).
71' A corner kick by Eintracht Frankfurt is thwarted by the well prepared Daniel Batz (Mainz).

70' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him. The ball is out of play. Eintracht Frankfurt will have a chance to score from a corner.
69' Urs Fischer prepares a substitution. Phillip Tietz is replaced by Nelson Weiper (Mainz).
69' Phillipp Mwene goes off the pitch and Nikolas Veratschnig (Mainz) comes on.

68' A cross into the box picks out Ayoube Amaimouni (Eintracht Frankfurt), who steps inside his marker and fizzes a shot well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Mainz will have a goal kick.
66' Jonathan Burkardt (Eintracht Frankfurt) blasts the ball high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Mainz will have a goal kick.
64' Problems for Albert Riera as Nnamdi Collins is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Elias Baum (Eintracht Frankfurt) replaces him.
63' Looks like Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.

61' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) latches on to a superb cross inside the box but only hits the crossbar with a fine header. What a chance! The ball goes out of play and Mainz will have a goal kick.
59' Sheraldo Becker (Mainz) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
58' The substitution has been made. Ayoube Amaimouni (Eintracht Frankfurt) has replaced Jean-Matteo Bahoya.
57' The possession of the ball – 37:63.
54' The Eintracht Frankfurt players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
52' Silvan Widmer (Mainz) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
50' Eintracht Frankfurt are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
48' Paul Nebel (Mainz) was too forceful with his tackle and Tobias Stieler interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
46' Sheraldo Becker (Mainz) strikes the ball towards goal from the middle of the penalty area, but his shot goes straight into the gloves of the goalkeeper.
46' Albert Riera has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Ellyes Skhiri comes on the pitch for Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' Tobias Stieler blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' Mainz fail to score from a corner as Michael Zetterer (Eintracht Frankfurt) leaps to collect the ball.
45+3' The corner is swung in but Mainz can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

45+1' Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt) finds himself some space around the penalty spot to connect with a fine free kick. His header is slightly mistimed and sails inches over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mainz.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) was quite harsh and Tobias Stieler didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
43' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header towards the bottom left corner is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
43' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Eintracht Frankfurt.
42' Tobias Stieler blows his whistle after Dominik Kohr (Mainz) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
40' Mainz can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

39' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) receives a clever long through ball and finds himself in a promising position inside the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and clears. The linesman signals a throw-in for Mainz.
37' Sheraldo Becker (Mainz) pounces on the cross and fires in a shot on goal from close range, but Michael Zetterer is alert and makes a decent save.
35' Paul Nebel (Mainz) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
34' Aurele Amenda (Eintracht Frankfurt) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
32' A corner kick by Mainz is thwarted by the well prepared Michael Zetterer (Eintracht Frankfurt).
29' The Eintracht Frankfurt players are exchanging some short passes.
27' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Tobias Stieler had an easy-decision to make.
25' Silvan Widmer (Mainz) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a goal kick.
24' This shall not pass! Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.

23' What a chance that is! Kaishu Sano (Mainz) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a goal kick.
22' Mainz take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
20' 1 - 1 Goal! Jean-Matteo Bahoya provides Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the bottom right corner. 1:1.
19' Jonathan Burkardt (Eintracht Frankfurt) announces himself with a close-range shot after a cross, but one of the defenders gets in the way of the ball to thwart him.
19' Eintracht Frankfurt string together a series of short passes.
18' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
15' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
14' Neat passing move from Eintracht Frankfurt in order to create new attacking opportunities.
12' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
11' Wow, what an escape. Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
10' Phillip Tietz (Mainz) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
6' 1 - 0 Goal! Sheraldo Becker plays it to Paul Nebel (Mainz), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Michael Zetterer. 1:0.
4' Sheraldo Becker (Mainz) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
3' Eintracht Frankfurt have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
1' Phillip Tietz (Mainz) has tested the patience of referee Tobias Stieler and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Mainz will take the kick-off.
Tobias Stieler is the one to supervise the game today.
